title: Not easy to clean, does not come apart
text: Not easy to clean, does not come apart. I liked the compact style of the cutter, with the nice roller handle. The cover was a bit odd, rolling over to close the device. However, the problem came when trying to clean it. I have had these small circular cutters before, and they all came apart for cleaning. This does not, and when you are trying to clean off the food, it rotates and just pushes it back INTO the cutter. I am not sure how you are supposed to get this completely cleaned. I put it in the dishwasher, but there is no way to disassemble and manually clean it. I would look for one that comes apart better
